education.degree: Master of Science in Data Science

education.institution: National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST)

responsibilities: Developed a langgraph-based agentic workflow to automate manual, repetitive pre and post deployment administrative tasks for a core service. Reduced time taken to build a new release from 81 to 25 minutes.
Developed the backend logic for a service that leveraged Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to search thousands of videos to identify unsafe driving behavior.
Designed questions and updated homeworks to reflect the latest techniques used in auditing AI-based decision systems.
Graded assignments for DS-1017: Responsible Data Science taught by Dr. Emily Black & Lucas Rosenblatt for the Spring '25 semester.
Held weekly office hours to assist students with homework, projects and other questions.
Developed a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)-based search system that accelerated narrative identification by producing an answer and retrieving its context from a closed-source dataset.
Set up the initial pipeline to process raw data, generate embeddings and store them in a vector database, while ensuring scalability for large data volumes.
Compared different RAG and retriever combinations on factual, complex and vague questions. Identified GraphRAG with a multi-query retriever as the ideal system with an overall 60% win-rate.

publications.citation: M. H. Naveed, U. S. Hashmi, N. Tajved, N. Sultan and A. Imran, "Assessing Deep Generative Models on Time Series Network Data," in IEEE Access, vol. 10

projects.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation for Financial Question-Answering
points: Background: LLMs often struggle with factual accuracy on financial queries due to structured/unstructured data and specialized terminology.
Work: Expanded on the FinanceBench paper by building a baseline model with 37% accuracy, then exploring semantic chunking and contextual retrieval.
Results: A Naive RAG system combined with semantic chunking achieved 54% accuracy — a 17% improvement over the baseline.
